title: When Gradient Importance Lies: Adaptive LoRA Rank Allocation Fails Under GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2605.07366v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adaptive rank allocation for LoRA - allocating more parameters to important layers and fewer to unimportant ones - consistently improves efficiency under supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We test whether this success transfers to reinforcement learning, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Using gradient-magnitude profiling on Qwen 2.5 1.5B with GSM8K, we find that, in our setting, it does not: proportional rank allocation degrades accuracy by 4.5 points compared to uniform allocation (70.0% vs. 74.5%), despite using identical parameter budgets. We identify two mechanisms behind this failure. First, the gradient landscape under GRPO is fundamentally flatter than under SFT: the max-to-min layer importance ratio is only 2.17x, whereas the layer concentration reported by Shi et al. translated_title: 当梯度重要性失灵：自适应LoRA秩分配在GRPO下失效
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.07366v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：LoRA的自适应秩分配——为重要层分配更多参数，为不重要层分配更少参数——在监督微调（SFT）下持续提升效率。我们测试了这种成功是否能迁移到强化学习，特别是组相对策略优化（GRPO）。使用Qwen 2.5 1.5B和GSM8K进行梯度幅度分析，我们发现，在我们的设置中，它不能：与均匀分配相比，比例秩分配使准确率下降了4.5个百分点（70.0%对74.5%），尽管使用了相同的参数预算。我们识别了这种失败背后的两种机制。首先，GRPO下的梯度景观从根本上比SFT更平坦：最大到最小层重要性比仅为2.17倍，而Shi等人（2024）报告的SFT层集中度（前30%的层携带超过80%的梯度信号）暗示最大/最小比远高于10倍。所有层都携带了有意义的梯度信息。
tldr: 该论文发现，在GRPO强化学习下，基于梯度重要性分配LoRA秩的自适应方法会降低模型性能，因为GRPO的梯度分布比SFT更均匀，导致自适应分配失效。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that adaptive LoRA rank allocation based on gradient importance degrades model performance under GRPO reinforcement learning, because GRPO's gradient distribution is flatter than SFT, rendering the adaptive allocation ineffective.
